no_head_on_same_lane.note: All visible vehicles travel same direction; no head-on opposing vehicles in same lane.

single_bulb_signal.note: No traffic signals, stop lights, or signal heads visible anywhere in illustration.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Background road on mid-right behind blue car shows solid yellow line on RIGHT edge of travel lanes with same-direction traffic, while white line is in middle - opposite of US rule requiring yellow on LEFT and white edge on RIGHT.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; certificates, calendars, driver cards, building emblem, shield and plates are blank shapes with icons/checkmarks/locks only.

result.summary: Illustration matches SR-22 filing concept and is text-free, but fails US right-hand traffic geometry due to yellow line on right edge of mid-right road.

teaching_correct.note: Concept of filing unlocking suspended license via DMV record is depicted correctly with no wrong driving geometry taught.

result.what_i_see: Left foreground woman stamps a gold-sealed certificate at a desk; center shows calendar icons arrowing to a DMV-like building and a locked card becoming unlocked; right foreground smiling driver in blue car holds a card with city roads behind.
